# incusos Provider

Terraform provider for managing IncusOS (`incus-osd`) host configuration, storage, services, and applications via the IncusOS HTTPS API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    incusos = {
      source = "reta-ygs/incusos"
    }
  }
}

# Option 1 (Recommended for teams):
# Keep the provider block empty and inject INCUS_REMOTE=node-01 (uses ~/.config/incus or INCUS_CONF)
# or INCUSOS_ADDRESS / INCUSOS_CLIENT_CERT / INCUSOS_CLIENT_KEY / INCUSOS_SERVER_CERT in CI/CD.
provider "incusos" {}

# Option 2: Explicitly select an Incus CLI remote
# provider "incusos" {
#   remote = "node-01"
# }

# Option 3: Explicit HTTPS + mTLS parameters
# provider "incusos" {
#   address          = "https://192.0.2.10:8443"
#   path_prefix      = "/os"
#   client_cert_path = "~/.config/incus/client.crt"
#   client_key_path  = "~/.config/incus/client.key"
#   server_cert_path = "~/.config/incus/servercerts/node-01.crt"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Base HTTPS URL of the IncusOS host (e.g., `https://192.0.2.10:8443`). Can also be set via `INCUSOS_ADDRESS`.
- `client_cert` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded TLS client certificate for mTLS authentication. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_CLIENT_CERT`.
- `client_cert_path` (String) Path to a PEM-encoded TLS client certificate file. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_CLIENT_CERT_PATH`.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded TLS client private key for mTLS authentication. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_CLIENT_KEY`.
- `client_key_path` (String) Path to a PEM-encoded TLS client private key file. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_CLIENT_KEY_PATH`.
- `config_dir` (String) Incus CLI configuration directory containing `config.yml`, `client.crt`, `client.key`, and `servercerts/`. Defaults to `INCUS_CONF` or the platform default (`~/.config/incus` on Linux).
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Disable TLS server certificate verification (not recommended for production). Can also be set via `INCUSOS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`.
- `network_confirmation_timeout` (String) Default rollback confirmation timeout duration for `incusos_system_network` changes (e.g., `60s`, `2m`). Set to `0` or `0s` to disable automatic rollback protection by default. Defaults to `60s`. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_NETWORK_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT`.
- `path_prefix` (String) URL path prefix before `/1.0/...`. Defaults to `/os` (the Incus HTTPS proxy path). Can also be set via `INCUSOS_PATH_PREFIX`.
- `remote` (String) Incus CLI remote name from `config.yml` to load connection address and TLS certificates from. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_REMOTE` or `INCUS_REMOTE` (matching the Incus CLI). Explicit attributes and `INCUSOS_*` environment variables take precedence over remote settings.
- `server_cert` (String) PEM-encoded server or CA TLS certificate to trust. Supports pinning self-signed Incus server certificates. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_SERVER_CERT`.
- `server_cert_path` (String) Path to a PEM-encoded server or CA TLS certificate file. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_SERVER_CERT_PATH`.
- `timeout` (String) HTTP request timeout as a Go duration string (e.g., `60s`, `5m`). Defaults to `60s`. Can also be set via `INCUSOS_TIMEOUT`.
